note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs. Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.
